bearn: bearn — child, son (at line 59 nominative plural 'children'; at line 67 it is instead the preterite of beirnan 'to run': 'him on mōd bearn' — 'it ran into his mind')
bēowulf: Bēowulf — Beowulf; here Scyld's son, the Danish king — not the poem's hero (nominative) · Bēowulf — Beowulf, son of Ecgtheow, the Geatish hero (nominative; accusative as object of nemnað)
cyn: cyn — kin, race, kind (accusative singular neuter; cf. 'kin')
dena: Dene — Danes (genitive plural; land Dena 'land of the Danes')
deniga: Dene — of the Danes (genitive plural, longer form; the prologue's Gār-Dena is the same people)
drēam: drēam — joy, mirth, festive music (accusative singular; the ancestor of 'dream', but meaning communal joy)
duguðe: duguð — body of tried retainers, court, nobility (genitive singular, feminine; cf. dugan 'to avail')
folce: folc — to the folk, people (dative singular)
for: for — for, because of (preposition) · for — before, in front of (preposition with dative)
fæder: fæder — father (here genitive: 'father's') · fæder — father (nominative singular; mīn fæder 'my father'; also God: Fæder alwalda 'Father almighty')
fǣhðe: fǣhð — feud, blood-feud (singular; the legal state of hostility that follows a killing — related to 'foe')
grendel: Grendel — Grendel (nominative; the name's meaning is unknown — perhaps related to grindan 'to grind') · Grendel — Grendel (accusative, object of wið)
healfdenes: Healfdene — Healfdene, king of the Danes, father of Hrothgar (genitive)
helm: helm — Helm, protector (nominative singular; literally 'helmet' — God as covering of the heavens)
hrōðgār: Hrōðgār — Hrothgar, king of the Danes, builder of Heorot (nominative) · Hrōðgār — Hrothgar (accusative; the person taught) · Hrōðgār — Hrothgar (vocative, in address)
hwæt: hwæt — what! lo! (interjection calling for attention; also the pronoun 'what')
hwīlum: hwīlum — at times, sometimes (adverb; the dative plural of hwīl — 'at whiles')
hēold: healdan — held, ruled; kept (to a place) (3rd singular preterite) · healdan — kept, maintained (3rd singular preterite; with ǣgwearde: kept watch)
maþelode: maþelian — spoke formally, made a speech (3rd singular preterite; from maþel 'assembly, speech')
mid: mid — with (preposition; here after its object: him mid 'with him') · mid — with (preposition; also before its object: mid Gēatum 'with the Geats')
mihte: magan — could, was able (3rd singular preterite; cf. 'might')
mæg: magan — am able, can (1st singular present of a preterite-present verb; cf. 'may')
mādmas: māþm — treasure, precious thing (accusative plural masculine; spelled mādm- for māþm-)
mē: ic — to me, for me (dative singular of ic; Mǣl is mē 'it is time for me') · ic — me (accusative singular, the shorter form; hē mē habban wile 'he will have me')
mīn: mīn — my (possessive adjective, nominative singular masculine) · mīn — my (accusative singular neuter, or vocative masculine; þēoden mīn 'my lord')
ond: ond — and (the usual spelling of and in this MS)
rīce: rīce — mighty one, powerful man (nominative singular; the same word means 'kingdom, power' — cf. bishopric, German Reich)
scyldinga: Scyldingas — of the Scyldings, the descendants of Scyld = the Danes (genitive plural)
scīr: scīr — bright, gleaming (adjective, nominative singular neuter; cf. 'sheer')
secgum: secg — to men (dative plural; a poetic word for 'man, warrior'; supplied by editors — Klaeber's brackets — where the manuscript dropped a word)
sefan: sefa — mind, heart, spirit (accusative singular, weak masculine)
symle: symbel — at the feast, banquet (dative singular)
sē: sē — he, that one; the (nominative singular masculine of the demonstrative; sē þe 'he who')
tō: tō — to, as, for (preposition) · tō — too (adverb; tō swȳð 'too severe') · tō — to (particle before the inflected infinitive: tō gecȳðanne 'for declaring') · tō — to, toward (adverb separated from its goal; tō ... gegnum gangan 'go straight to it') · tō — to (before a bare infinitive: tō fēran 'to go')
wedera: Wederas — Weders, another name for the Geats (genitive plural)
wine: wine — friend, friend-and-lord (nominative singular; wine Scyldinga 'friend of the Scyldings') · wine — friend (accusative singular)
wyrd: wyrd — fate, destiny (nominative singular feminine; cf. 'weird')
wæs: wesan — was (3rd singular preterite) · wesan — be (imperative singular; Wæs þū hāl 'be hale', a greeting)
wēold: wealdan — wielded, ruled (3rd singular preterite; takes the dative)
ðonne: þonne — than (after a comparative); also then, when (adverb, conjunction)
ðā: sē/þā — the, those (nominative plural of the demonstrative); as adverb: then · þā — those, the (accusative plural of the demonstrative) · þā — when (conjunction; ðā ic of searwum cwōm 'when I came from')
þe: þe — who, which, that (the indeclinable relative particle)
þone: sē — whom, that (accusative singular masculine of the demonstrative, here relative) · sē — that (accusative singular masculine of the demonstrative, qualifying a noun: þone hilderǣs 'that battle-rush')
þonne: þonne — when, whenever; than (conjunction) · þonne — then, at that time (adverb)
þā: þā — then (adverb); also: those, the (plural demonstrative); who, which (relative) · when (conjunction) · þā — the (accusative singular feminine of the demonstrative before a noun)
þē: þe — which, that (relative particle; Klaeber prints þē, emended — the MS has only 'þ') · þū — you (dative singular: to you, with you) · þū — you (accusative singular; þæt ic þē sōhte 'that I should seek you')
þū: þū — you (2nd person singular pronoun; cf. 'thou')
þǣr: þǣr — there (adverb) · þǣr — where (relative adverb; þǣr ic fīfe geband 'where I bound five')
þȳ: sē/þæt — that (instrumental singular; for þȳ māne 'for that crime')
āhte: āgan — possessed, ruled (3rd singular preterite; cognate with 'ought', 'owe')
ārstafum: ārstafas — favor, kindness, mercy (dative plural; ār 'grace' + staf 'staff, support')
ōretmecgas: ōretmecg — warriors, fighters (accusative plural, or nominative plural; ōret 'combat' + mecg 'man')
